description: Clark returns from the New Krypton conflict, defeats Lord Nor and finally marries Lois for real, shifting the series from courtship to the complications of married life. Their first year together brings the Wedding Destroyer, Mxyzptlk, red kryptonite, Tempus's presidential takeover and the hidden legacy of Lex Luthor through his son. Alongside those threats, Lois and Clark confront whether a Kryptonian and a human can have children, ending with grim medical news followed by the unexplained arrival of a baby in their home.

s04e01.description: Lois and Clark's relationship hangs in the balance as Clark is forced to adhere to Kryptonian law and marry the woman he was pledged to at birth.

s04e02.description: Clark faces charges of treason for betraying the people of New Krypton after returning to Earth to stop Lord Nor's hostile takeover.

s04e03.description: As Lois and Clark prepare to try marriage again, escaped 'Wedding Destroyer' Myrtle Beech targets their ceremony in revenge for the investigation that sent her to prison. A rigged ring, her manipulative therapist and a persistent tabloid reporter threaten the wedding until the couple finally reaches the altar.

s04e04.description: The newlyweds travel back in time with H.G. Wells to remove a curse cast on the couple's love centuries ago.

s04e05.description: A scientist's youth-draining experiment turns young victims, including Jimmy, into elderly men within days. Lois and Clark race to reverse the process while Lois is unsettled by the discovery that Superman may age far more slowly than she will.

s04e06.description: An ex-informant is shot while Lois is holding the gun, and video evidence makes the murder case against her look airtight. Clark and Lois's defense team investigate the impossible shooting as Jefferson Cole's holographic technology reveals how carefully she has been framed.

s04e07.description: With Lois imprisoned for a murder she did not commit, Superman engineers her escape so she and Clark can investigate the frame-up from outside the system. They trace the conspiracy back toward Jefferson Cole while police hunt Lois as a fugitive.

s04e08.description: Lois and Clark befriend another married couple, Bob and Carol, hoping to build a normal social life outside the Daily Planet. Bob's concealed identity and unusual powers expose a conflict that pulls both couples into a super-powered confrontation and ruins the ordinary friendship Lois and Clark were trying to establish.

s04e09.description: A real-estate con artist tries to frighten Lois and Clark out of their townhouse by staging a haunting, only for the scheme to awaken a genuine ghost. The couple must uncover Katie Banks's unfinished history before the supernatural threat takes control of their home.

s04e10.description: Lois becomes editor in chief when Perry gets a corporate promotion; spoiled, wealthy young brothers conspire to assassinate Superman.

s04e11.description: Mxyzptlk traps Metropolis in an endlessly repeating Christmas Eve, with each cycle leaving people more hopeless and destructive. Clark is one of the few able to notice the repetitions and has to outthink the imp before the city loses the will to escape the loop.

s04e12.description: Red kryptonite makes Superman's powers surge unpredictably, prompting the mayor to order him out of action. Lois and Jimmy trace the radiation to Perry's son Jerry, who is being used by criminals planning a massive sonic-extortion attack on Metropolis.

s04e13.description: A corrupt, fame-seeking tycoon tries to discredit Superman by releasing a photograph of the Man of Steel and Lois in an embrace.

s04e14.description: Superman-obsessed Penny Barnes uses a computer profile to identify Jimmy Olsen as the man she believes is secretly Superman and begins dating him to get closer. Her mistake puts both of them in danger when her employer's lethal satellite scheme convinces him she really is Superman's girlfriend.

s04e15.description: Tempus returns from the future as presidential candidate John Doe and uses a stolen subliminal device to make voters trust him automatically. After winning the election, he turns the government against Superman and ultimately sabotages a time window to strand Clark outside normal time.

s04e16.description: With Clark trapped outside time and Tempus ruling through mass brainwashing, Lois and H.G. Wells bring the alternate-universe Clark to Metropolis as a replacement Superman. Together they destroy Tempus's subliminal system, stop a nuclear launch and use the broken time window's timing to recover Lois's Clark.

s04e17.description: The Daily Planet gets a new owner, Leslie Luckabee, just as a lethal super-fast vigilante called Vixen begins killing people tied to Lex Luthor's former companies. Superman discovers Vixen is a machine, but her destruction only deepens the mystery of who built her and why Leslie is being targeted.

s04e18.description: Lois and Clark investigate murders connected to Vixen while Leslie Luckabee courts Lois and presents himself as Lex Luthor's heir. Evidence of a shadow-like assassin and a hidden figure called Mr. Smith suggests that the Daily Planet's new owner is part of a larger plan to revive Luthor's legacy.

s04e19.description: Clark investigates Leslie Luckabee's invented past and uncovers that the disfigured Mr. Smith is the real Lex Luthor Jr., with Leslie serving as his public stand-in. Lex Jr. uses a neural device to spy on and torture Lois, then kidnaps her in an attempt to replace Clark in her life.

s04e20.description: A fugitive from the mob switches bodies with Clark causing him to search for a way to reverse the process.

s04e21.description: Children across Metropolis are disappearing into the care of embittered toy inventor Harold Kripstly, who believes kidnapping them will protect them from abusive adults. Lois and Clark follow the missing-child cases to his hidden refuge before his distorted idea of rescue traps even more children.

s04e22.description: Lois and Clark reveal Superman's identity to Sam Lane while seeking an answer to whether they can have children, only to learn that Clark may be unable to father one with Lois. A telekinetic criminal then kidnaps their parents, and after the family is rescued an unexplained baby is left in Clark's old bassinet at the couple's home.
